title: SummarizePetitionObjectives
description: A short summary of a petition's objectives, about a tweet long, in the source language and machine-translated into the other EU languages, emitted by the translation service. Keyed by (system, petition_id) as UpsertPetition is; a sink applies it to the existing petition and never creates one. Carries the objectives it summarises, so a sink can drop a summary of text the petition no longer has.

source_lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the source text's language, or 'und' when nobody could tell.

summaries.description: ISO 639-1 code -> summary. The source language's own summary included; the others are its machine translations.
